snippet.title: Rocket League® - Season 24 | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Season 24 launches on September 23rd, featuring the new Honor Duel 1v1 feature, Black Market Trade-In, new Rocket Pass cars including the Volkswagen Golf GTI 50 and Dominus GT 76, and more!
